source_reconciliation.boundary: The historical index is evidence of intended/researched modules and historical lifecycle state. It is not present-day implementation, empirical, A-01, native or production proof.

allocation_rules: SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-002 remains authoritative: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and PROSE are the current internal systems; P6 does not create additional first-class systems.
A module may remain a first-class user capability while executing headlessly; headless interaction does not imply a dedicated mini-app or first-class system.
A historical branch, archive, research closure, implementation candidate or qualification pack is preserved evidence but cannot become current owner/control authority merely by existence or recency.
Where a module's semantic owner is not already canonical, P6 records OWNER_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED rather than silently assigning its domain semantics to CORE.
CORE may provide shared artifact, model, connector, action, work, data, UX and execution infrastructure to headless modules without thereby owning all module-specific semantics.
Book/Prose ownership boundaries remain strict: generic WRITING is not silently collapsed into PROSE, and Prose cannot write Book canonical state.
Governance LEDGER and EXPECTATION records are not automatically proof that the historical Household Ledger or Response Expectation Engine product modules are implemented.

summary_counts.note: Categories overlap at the semantic level only where explicitly stated as composite/partial; every historical module row appears exactly once in the modules array. Counts are allocation/census classes, not implementation-completion percentages.

material_findings: The historical 40-module count is real; the current EXPECTATION-REGISTRY array omitted DATA, PHONEOPS and PHYSICALAI and therefore listed only 37 names.

Most historical modules were research-closed but explicitly NOT_AUTHORIZED for implementation and NOT_PROVEN empirically/production. Those historical labels cannot be used as current completion proof.

Learning is the only historical module row that directly maps to an already-declared first-class current system. Curriculum maps inside Learning; Manuscript and StoryBible map inside Book; Chat, Projects and Experience map to Core shared runtime; generic Writing remains a boundary/composite question rather than a new system by default.

The document tool family contains substantial preserved implementation evidence outside current canonical owner admission; P6 preserves it so future work should re-admit/requalify useful assets rather than restart research or implementation blindly.

AI Income and Living Portfolio remain important historical product domains with preserved research but are not current topology systems. They require an explicit owner/topology decision before executable implementation, preventing accidental architecture creation from branch names or chat titles.
Household Ledger is distinct from governance ledgers. Response Expectation Engine is distinct from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY. These name collisions must remain explicit until P7/P8 evidence resolves them.
PhoneOps is absorbed/no-standalone; Physical AI is deferred optional; CAD is current headless interoperability-only direction rather than a dedicated maintained system.

P6 does not imply that the 27 unresolved/headless modules all need separate systems. The preferred resolution may be a small number of headless tool-portfolio owner contracts over Core shared infrastructure.
completion_rule: P6 is complete when every historically tracked module row has one truthful current allocation/disposition and no research status is promoted into implementation proof. This result does not build modules, create new systems, grant implementation authority, transfer qualification PASS, or certify native/production readiness.
next_global_action: Advance to P7 orphan/unallocated branch-workstream census. Use P6 owner gaps and name collisions as search targets; classify branch families/workstreams/qualification lanes as historical-only, superseded, active-owned or UNALLOCATED without allowing an orphan branch to create architecture.
